title.zh: 将八打雁省图伊市镇奥比斯波小学的名称变更为Gregorio Agoncillo小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Mababang Paaralan Ng Obispo in the Municipality of Tuy, Province of Batangas, to Mababang Paaralang Gregorio Agoncillo
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Mababang Paaralan Ng Obispo in the Municipality of Tuy, Province of Batangas, to Mababang Paaralang Gregorio Agoncillo
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Mababang Paaralan Ng Obispo tại Thị trấn Tuy, Tỉnh Batangas thành Mababang Paaralang Gregorio Agoncillo
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Mababang Paaralan Ng Obispo ในเทศบาล Tuy, จังหวัด Batangas เป็น Mababang Paaralang Gregorio Agoncillo
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Mababang Paaralan Ng Obispo di Kotamadya Tuy, Provinsi Batangas menjadi Mababang Paaralang Gregorio Agoncillo
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Mababang Paaralan Ng Obispo di Perbandaran Tuy, Wilayah Batangas menjadi Mababang Paaralang Gregorio Agoncillo

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6798_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Mababang Paaralan ng Obispo in the Municipality of Tuy, Province of Batangas, is hereby changed to Mababang Paaralang Gregorio Agoncillo.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
